eps.d: Paul Dangerfield, local GP, forensic surgeon and recently widowed father of two teenage children, is leant on to clear an officer of a charge of brutality.
Paul's son Marty gets caught up in an accidental shootingwhich results in the death of a local farmer. Dangerfield is called out to examine the body.

Paul's shaky relationship with Di Ken Jackson deteriorates further when he promises to keep an old patient's secret for 24 hours. He finds his family life hardly any less complicated when his son Marty, feeling neglected and alienated, takes off to Aberdovey.
When Dangerfield is called in to examine a suspected rape victim, he is startled to see his girlfriend Kate Durrani is the duty solicitor assigned to defend the man accused of the attack.

Dangerfield is called in to re-examine Diana, the suspected rape victim, when she says she has been attacked again. His daughter Alison, meanwhile, discovers the fine line between amorous advances and date rape.
An aerial photographer spots a corpse in a field. When DI Ken Johnson investigates he calls in Dangerfield to supervise the forensic examination.
When the body of a naked woman is found by a canal, the police must discover who she is, when she died and how her body got there.
Ken Jackson turns to Paul Dangerfield and Terri Morgan to find the crucial piece of evidence that will clear his name when a suspect dies while in police custody.
A storm reveals strange things buried in the garden of a house with only one occupant. It seems an open and shut case - until Paul Dangerfield digs a little deeper.
Disturbing events follow Rozand Joanna 's disagreement over a child's injuries.
Dangerfield wrestles with his conscience after a businessman is found dead.
Ken becomes obsessed with a beautiful, young call girt.
When a body is dragged out of a quarry, the only clue to its identity is the curtain wrapped around it. Meanwhile, Al and Ben set off on their camping trip.
When an SAS man is found dead in a shallow grave, Ken is sure that a professional killer is involved, but Paul disagrees.
A possible conflict of interest arises when Paul Dangerfield and Joanna Stevens become involved in a family tragedy.
In the first of a two-part story, Paul takes his family to Norfolk for a holiday, but is unwittingly drawn into a dark mystery.
In Norfolk, Paul discovers that he knows too much about the death of Susan Wood for his own safety.
Unexpected family pressures lead Paul and Joanna's relationship towards crisis point.
Paul Dangerfield finds hisjob as police surgeon under threat as he becomes embroiled in a political feud.
The wife of a suicide victim hints that malevolent forces may have caused her husband's death.
The disappearance of a young boy leads to a full-scale emergency. Once the abductor's motives become clear, the police enlist Paul to help.
When a policeman starts behaving strangely, Paul's instincts to help lead to a tangled web of deceit and prejudice.
While giving evidence as prosecution witness at a murder trial, Paul finds his impartiality severely tested.
Dangerfield 's search for independence continues, but is her dream of rural idyll about to be shattered?
When a romantic evening by the water ends in a suicide pact, police soon recover the body of a young woman-but the body of her lover has disappeared.
Paul Dangerfield and his colleagues at the practice are worried when patients report home visits by a GP using their surgery's name as a calling card.

Following the death of his wife, William Ashurst an old friend of Paul Dangerfield's father, returns to the area of his childhood, but is regarded with suspicion by the other residents of the Foxwood estate.
A prisoner confides in Dangerfield following a prison riot. When the man later dies in police custody, Paul decides to investigate. Meanwhile, Marty is determined to help Al in her hour of need.
A routine investigation into a probable cot death at a remote farmhouse reveals suspicious evidence.
Jayne Sharman, one of Dangerfield's patients, reveals she has been raped.
Dangerfield befriends a young Serbian who has been beaten up in Warwick.
Dangerfield is called out to confirm the death of a young woman who has drowned.
Dangerfield responds to a seemingly routine house call and finds himself in the middle of an armed siege.
Dangerfield gets drawn into a complex family affair after examining a body which has been dragged from a river.
When Hannah Gresham goes missing, her parents and her fiance, Adam, are distraught. But Dangerfield is not convinced that Adam is telling the truth.
Marty enjoys a night of passion with Jojo, while Dangerfield is called to examine three teenage boys found in possession of ecstacy tablets.
An apparent case of euthanasia finds Dangerfield in the awkward position of suspecting Dr Jonathan Paige , an old friend and colleague.

eps.t: And Lips That We Might Tell
eps.d: As AI's wedding day approaches, Dangerfield gets drawn into a complicated crash investigation and unwittingly becomes the victim of a disturbed woman.
Dr Jonathan Paige is immediately thrown into conflict with the new DI, Gillian Cramer, over a drunken teenage girl and a suspicious death.
A pub brawl sets Dr Paige and DI Cramer at odds after a body is found.
Dr Paige assesses a young schizophrenic man and advises his mother that he needs professional help. She persuades Dr Paige that she can cope with her son, but the next day she is found dead.
DS Diamond's investigation into Stanley Courtney 's confession to murder is interrupted by Dr Paige, who believes Courtney is mentally unstable and unfit for police questioning.
A local artist is found dead at her home, but when Dr Paige discovers injection marks on the body, DI Cramer becomes suspicious.

A local composer and cellist who has been to the surgery suffering from noise pollution from a neighbour, flees when he is found over the strangled body of the girl upstairs. Meanwhile, Shaaban walks out on the practice.

Paige's son Charlie attempts to have a heart-to-heart with his father regarding his medical studies. However, his problems are overtaken by those of a friend organising a rally against government interference in the farming industry.
Dr Paige is called out to the body of a man dressed as an angel, but his suspicions are aroused when it is claimed he accidentally fell out of a hot-air balloon.
A woman falls to her death from the roof of her house and her husband becomes withdrawn, but when Dr Paige investigates, he unearths some family troubles.

When a man is found hanged, Dr Paige and DI Cramer discover a suicide note and a blackmail note, and their investigations revive memories of the village publican's son who disappeared six years before.
Dr Paige is called to attend Bailey, a paranoid police informant held at a safe house. But Bailey's paranoia proves correct and Cramer suffers when the bu I lets start to fly.
DI Cramer's life is in the balance following the shooting, and when Dr Paige confirms a hitchhiker's death, skin found under the fingernails links him to a number of previous murders.
Dr Paige and DS Diamond are on their way to join DI Cramer in London for her commendation ceremony.
When Rhona Bishop suffers a series of terrifying attacks, the police suspect her former abductor is guilty of the assaults, but Paige has an inkling her husband could be involved.

A pregnant woman who is in custody after a drink-driving accident falls onto a concrete bed and miscarries her baby. She accuses Cramer of assaulting her, but when she disappears and her husband is suspected of another assault, Paige starts to smell a rat.

Teenager Jade Prior goes missing from home after an argument with her stepfather Gary. Jade's mother Karen suspects Gary's son Lee knows more about the disappearance than he is letting on, while Cramer believes Jade's troubled friend Danny may hold some vital clues.

Paige is called to the police station to examine a teenager who has been hurt during a fight. When the young man accuses him of sexual assault, the police surgeon finds himself hauled before an investigation board.
An immigration raid on a farm gets out of hand and the workers, farm owner and his son are all arrested. But when one of them collapses in jail Paige realises she has gone into labour.

Gillian Cramer 's ex-husband, CID officer David Moore, asks her to put in a good word for him with Warwickshire police, who are carrying out an internal investigation into irregularities in his force. She uncovers disturbing information and asks Jonathan Paige for advice.
Paige is giving evidence in court against a man who is on trial for murder. When the accused suddenly realises that Paige is his former GP, what looks like a cut-and-dried case becomes more complex.
When a local woman falls to her death from a bedroom window, her distraught husband is convinced that there is a connection with the ghost of a woman who was murdered in the house many years before.
A routine visit to a patient in hospital turns into a life-or-death situation for Dr Paige when he becomes the hostage of an escaped convict.
As DI Cramer and Dr Paige try to reconcile their work and private lives, they are faced with a suspicious case of hit-and-run.
Dl Cramer and Dr Paige are preparing for their wedding day, until he notices a suspicious face from the past.
